title: Reflect section heading
description: The centred stack that opens every Reflect section: a pill badge, a big weight-500 heading filled with a top-to-bottom ink-to-70% gradient, a muted 16px lead and an optional row of buttons. Three sizes: hero (44→72px), section (40→56px) and display (40→72px).
notes: a \n in the title is a line break on desktop only; phones wrap naturally
children go under the lead (buttons); they wrap and stack on narrow screens
name: reflect-heading

props.description: h1 for the page's opening heading, h2 elsewhere
